items.title: Where to preorder the updated Mac Mini and Mac Studio
items.summary: Apple has announced two new processors, the M6 and M5 Ultra, as well as updated Mac Mini and Mac studio machines powered by them. news_assignments.headline: Trump says Canada to face 50% auto, steel tariffs from 2027

items.title: Trump says Canada to face 50% auto, steel tariffs from 2027
items.summary: The latest threat comes after the neighbors failed to reach a deal to avert a 50% US levy on a range of other Canadian goods. Ottawa says it plans to impose retaliatory tariffs.

items.title: Trump says U.S. will hike Canada auto tariffs to 50% as trade war escalates
items.summary: President Donald Trump said the U.S. will raise tariffs on imports of cars, trucks and auto parts from Canada to 50% on Jan. 1, 2027

items.title: ‘We don’t need Canada’: Trump threatens to double auto tariffs after trade talks collapse
items.summary: US tariffs ​on all Canadian cars and trucks, automotive parts and steel will be increased to 50% starting January 1, 2027, President Donald Trump said ​in a social ‌post on Monday. Doubling down on his threats, Trump said the US does not “need” Canada after trade talks between the two countries collapsed over the weekend.

items.title: Trump threatens 50% tariffs on all cars and trucks from Canada amid trade fight

news_assignments.headline: Canada announces retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. as the countries' trade fight deepens

items.title: Canada announces retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. as the countries' trade fight deepens
items.summary: The measures come after President Trump imposed 50% tariffs on many Canadian goods and threatened more after trade talks broke down on Friday.

items.title: Canada unveils retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of U.S. goods
items.summary: Canadian trade negotiators left the U.S. last week after failing to clinch a trade deal that would stop President Donald Trump's new tariffs from taking effect.

items.title: Canada to announce measures to protect workers as trade war with US deepens
items.summary: As the US escalates its trade war with Canada, Ottawa is preparing to hit back. With new tariffs threatening its car industry, as well as a wave of other products, Canada has announced its finance, labor and industry will be announcing new countermeasures to protect workers whose jobs may be at risk.

items.title: Canada announces retaliatory tariffs on $20 billion worth of US goods, unveils support measures
